product_one_liner.value: Doxis is an AI-powered enterprise content platform that classifies, extracts and understands business documents and automates document workflows for organizations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes Doxis as managing enterprise documents and automating workflows with AI.

pricing_page.notes: A public page describes deployment and licensing options, including unlimited and subscription-based licenses, although it does not list prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are listed on SER Group’s customer references page.

employee_band.notes: The company reports more than 900 employees, which is outside every allowed band. The schema requires an enum value; 201-500 is only the nearest permitted fallback and is not asserted as the company’s count.

hq_location.notes: The source identifies SER Group as headquartered in Bonn, Germany.

founded_year.notes: SER Group is described as founded in 1984.

eng_blog.notes: The index is a general product, category and customer-content blog; the inspected index and technical-post candidates do not establish two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Doxis AI.dp documentation portal includes API reference, SDK documentation, release notes and several platform sections.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live full-time Full Stack AI Engineer posting says Doxis is hiring three engineers and describes AI/ML model work.

model_provider.value: No single fixed provider is specified: Doxis describes a composable, customer-configurable AI approach, and Doxis AI.dp documentation lists customer-provided OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
model_provider.notes: The public FAQ says customers can connect specific models per process and often use a privately hosted LLM; the AI.dp docs list the supported bring-your-own-provider integrations.

compliance_certs.notes: The company certification page names SOC 2, ISO 27001 and EU GDPR certification; other SOC reports are not included because the requested list is limited to the named categories.

last_funding.notes: The latest recorded round is a March 2024 private-equity growth investment from TA Associates. The amount is described as undisclosed; 0 is the schema-required neutral numeric placeholder, not a claim that the round raised zero dollars.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile identifies the latest round as March 21, 2024, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; the TA investment announcement confirms the round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A full-time Business Development Representative posting invites candidates to apply and includes an active Apply now link.

launched_6mo.notes: On June 17, 2026, Doxis announced newly unveiled Ask Doxi, Agent Manager and enhanced Superhuman Search features, within the six-month window before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The January 19, 2026 announcement names new Chief AI Officer, Chief Revenue Officer and Vice President of Sales EMEA appointments, all within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The BDR posting names Pipedrive as its CRM; the GTM automation posting names 6sense, Salesforce Account Engagement, Salesloft, Clay and Cognism.
